title: My Family Home
text:
My name is Anna. I live in a small house with my mother, my father and my brother. Our house has a blue door and a big garden. My brother likes to play football in the garden.

Every Sunday, we have lunch together in the kitchen. My mother cooks soup and my father makes a salad. After lunch, we walk to the park with our dog, Max.

questions.text: Who lives with Anna in her house?
What does Anna's mother cook for Sunday lunch?
How does Anna probably feel about Sunday lunch with her family?
options: She does not want to see her family

questions.text: Why does the family probably walk to the park after lunch?
options: To spend time together with their dog
To look for a lost dog

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land next to a house where plants and flowers grow
a sport played with a round ball by two teams of eleven players
the room in a house where food is cooked
a cold dish of raw vegetables, often eaten with lunch or dinner

paragraph_translations: Nazywam się Anna. Mieszkam w małym domu z mamą, tatą i bratem. Nasz dom ma niebieskie drzwi i duży ogród. Mój brat lubi grać w piłkę nożną w ogrodzie.
Każdą niedzielę jemy razem obiad w kuchni. Mama gotuje zupę, a tata robi sałatkę. Po obiedzie idziemy z naszym psem Maxem do parku.
